parameters.name: BackendServers
parameters.description: The list of backend servers to add. You can modify up to 20 backend servers in each call.

sub_parameters.name: ServerId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the backend server.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The server type of the backend server. Valid values:
- **ens**: ENS instance.
- **eni**: elastic network interfaces (ENIs) instance. The backend server is a network interface controller (NIC).

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: **0** to **100**.

> A value of 0 indicates that no requests are forwarded to the backend server.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing instance.
